title: Checkout queue retry restored a failed job
description: A synthetic checkout worker timed out while processing an app-owned job. The queue had no sustained backlog.
resolution_summary: A single allowlisted retry succeeded after reviewing the transient failure.
resolution_steps: Inspect the failed job and current incident version.
Request the app-owned retry through the action policy.
Verify the recorded result and watch for repeated failure.

title: Repeated checkout timeout needed operator review
description: A synthetic checkout job failed after its first retry. The retry budget required human approval before another attempt.
resolution_summary: An operator reviewed the repeated error and approved a second bounded retry.
resolution_steps: Inspect both failure events and the retry count.
Request a retry with the current incident version.
Wait for a human decision and inspect the applied result.

title: Checkout latency rose during dependency degradation
description: A simulated payment dependency slowed checkout requests and increased queue wait time.
resolution_summary: The operator restored the simulated dependency and confirmed checkout latency recovered.
resolution_steps: Compare queue delay with dependency health.
Escalate the dependency issue to the responsible operator.
Verify sustained recovery before proposing incident resolution.

title: Payment gateway outage stopped authorization
description: Synthetic payment authorizations failed across regions after a gateway configuration exercise.
resolution_summary: An incident commander coordinated a reviewed rollback and verified authorization recovery.
resolution_steps: Preserve diagnostic evidence and notify the incident commander.
Have an authorized operator review the gateway configuration.
Confirm synthetic authorization probes recover before requesting resolution.

title: Duplicate payment callback delayed reconciliation
description: A synthetic callback arrived twice and reconciliation flagged a duplicate reference.
resolution_summary: The operator confirmed idempotent processing and replayed the approved reconciliation fixture.
resolution_steps: Compare callback identifiers and ledger state.
Confirm that duplicate delivery did not create a second payment.
Ask the operator to review reconciliation and verify its result.

title: Database connection pool exhausted
description: Synthetic traffic exhausted available database connections and raised request latency.
resolution_summary: An operator identified a held connection in the exercise and restored pool capacity.
resolution_steps: Inspect pool utilization and waiting requests.
Ask the database operator to review long-running work.
Verify connection pressure and application latency return to baseline.

title: Database disk pressure blocked writes
description: A synthetic storage-capacity exercise filled a database volume and caused write failures.
resolution_summary: An authorized operator restored storage capacity and verified transactional writes.
resolution_steps: Capture storage pressure and write failure evidence.
Escalate to the database incident commander.
Have an authorized operator restore capacity and verify write integrity.

title: Notification delivery fixture timed out once
description: A synthetic notification job hit a transient timeout without repeated delivery failure.
resolution_summary: One policy-approved retry delivered the fixture successfully.
resolution_steps: Inspect the delivery fixture and failure timestamp.
Request the allowlisted retry if current policy permits it.
Verify one recorded delivery and no duplicate notification.

title: Notification backlog followed provider throttling
description: A simulated provider throttled outbound messages and increased queue age.
resolution_summary: The operator reduced the exercise load and observed backlog recovery.
resolution_steps: Compare throttle events with queue age.
Ask the operator to review the synthetic sending rate.
Observe backlog drain before proposing resolution.

title: Search index lag followed a stalled import
description: A synthetic catalog import stalled and search results missed recently added records.
resolution_summary: The search operator recovered the simulated import and verified representative queries.
resolution_steps: Compare source record IDs with indexed record IDs.
Escalate the stalled import for an operator decision.
Validate representative search results after recovery.

title: Search fixture retry recovered a transient import error
description: One app-owned search import fixture failed transiently with no broader index lag.
resolution_summary: A bounded retry restored the fixture and the sampled record became searchable.
resolution_steps: Inspect the failed fixture and current retry count.
Request an allowlisted retry after checking policy.
Verify the import result and sampled source ID.

title: Identity session validation rejected valid sign-ins
description: A synthetic identity configuration exercise caused valid sessions to fail audience validation.
resolution_summary: The identity operator corrected the exercise configuration and verified sign-in recovery.
resolution_steps: Record the generic validation error and affected service.
Ask the identity operator to review issuer and audience configuration.
Verify valid sessions succeed and invalid sessions remain denied.
